messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] Spike in GPU OOMs detected on runtime-prod eu-west-2 (pool: prefill-pool-02). 27 container restarts in 5m. Paging @mike_oncall. Severity: Sev2.

mike_oncall: I'm on call, joining bridge. Can someone drop logs and tail /var/log/runtime/*.log?

sara: pulling logs now — seeing repeated CUDA: out of memory during prefill phase. Long-context requests (~32k tokens) causing KV cache blowout; allocs hit ~40GB on A100-40GB, containers restart with SIGKILL.

jess: confirmed on metrics — 15% of requests to /v1/stream are erroring with 500s, latency spikes. Customer impact: elevated error rate for any long-window customers. Starting mitigation plan.

mike_oncall: mitigation step 1: enable soft rejection for >8k token prefill at proxy layer. Pushing config via k8s.

jess: running command now:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/pool-proxy PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 --overwrite
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/pool-proxy
```
Will watch rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout started for deploy/pool-proxy in inference namespace — 3/3 pods updated.

sara: mitigation step 2: enable fallback routing to coldmodel (lower VRAM) for requests above threshold. Applying route rule:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/routes/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","if_prefill_tokens_gt":8192,"target":"coldmodel-v1"}'
```

rohit: customer ops checking affected tenant list — currently see spike for tenant: legalbot.ai and docflow-inc. Drafting comms.

mike_oncall: cordoning a problematic node to prevent noisy neighbors taking capacity:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-eu-west-2-17
kubectl drain gpu-node-eu-west-2-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

sara: also toggled kcache eviction threshold to 8GB to reduce KV cache retention: `kubectl -n inference patch cm runtime-config --patch '{"data":{"kcache.max_kv_bytes":"8589934592"}}'` — applied.

jess: monitoring dashboard — OOM restarts dropping from 27->4 in last 10m, error rate down to ~3%. :white_check_mark:

mike_oncall: keeping oncall for 60m to confirm stability. Next steps: create postmortem, schedule change to prefill token limits + adaptive batching, and add automated mitigation runbook.

incident-bot: Incident updated: Severity remains Sev2 until stable for 60m. Channel: #incidents. Runbook: prefills >8k => fallback to coldmodel; new config set.

rohit: customer comms: sending interim note to affected tenants — informing about rate-limiting for long contexts and temporary routing to lower-memory variants. Will share template in #customer-success.

jess: created ticket INC-1823 with short summary + action items: postmortem, permanent routing rule, telemetry alert tuning, recommend default PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=4096 for hosted tier.

mike_oncall: thanks team. If nothing flares in 60m I'll close the bridge and mark for postmortem handoff. :bow:

sara: leaving logs and stack traces in the incident ticket. Will follow up on kernel-level traces and CUDA allocator findings.

deploy-bot: Incident bridge closed (manual) — reason: mitigations showing sustained improvement. Please follow up in INC-1823 for remediation and RCA.

rohit: I'll coordinate customer follow-ups in the morning. Good job all.
